name: Diagonal Gaussian KL
description: KL(q||N(0,I)) for q=N(mean,diag(exp(logvar))); sums all latent features per example then reduces batch (mean default).
usage: kl = gaussian_kl(mu, logvar); add once to the VAE reconstruction objective.

parameters.reduction: none per-example, mean batch, or sum batch

examples.title: Train a VAE with Gaussian KL regularization
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 z=torch.randn(2,generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 x=torch.stack((z[0],z[1],z[0]+z[1],z[0]-z[1],z[0]*0.5,z[1]*0.5,z.sum(),z.prod()))
 return {"x":synth.Tensor(x)}
ds=synth.Spec("gaussian-kl-vae",generator=samples,size=24,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("vae",split="train")
val=ds.for_recipe("vae",split="val",like=train)
model=build("vae","tiny",in_features=8,latent_dim=2,hidden_dims=[8])
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="vae",recipe_config={"loss":"gaussian-kl","kl_weight":0.5},max_epochs=1,batch_size=8,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
